Exodus

Introduction

The word Iksudu comes from Grigu language which means “leaving/departing”. In this reading_document, (here) is written about the Lord causing_ his people _to_leave/depart from slavery in the place called Ihiptu. This confirmed that the Lord is indeed the true God (MS Manama) and above of all, because no (one) can hinder him from what he wanted to do.

This reading_document, (here) is written the story about (what) Israil's descendant(s) had experienced, and this is divided into three: 1/ the enslaving of_them in Ihiptu, and the causing_ of them _to_leave/depart by the Lord which he caused_ Muwisis _to_lead who was adopted by the princess; 2/ the helping of the Lord with them when they were_chased by the Ihiptuhanons on their walking going to the Mount Sinay, and was_given food_to_eat and water_to_drink on the mountain; 3/ the revealing of the Lord to Muwisis on the Mount Sinay, and he gave Muwisis the Law and their making of agreement; 4/ at the end, the making of the tent which is the container of the Agreement and the instruction about worship.

In short (here) is told in this reading_document about (what) God has done at the time when he caused_ his enslaved people _to_leave/depart and he caused_ them _to_stand_up as one nation who has_hope that it's good in_the_future.

Muwisis is the most impurtant person in this story and God chose him to lead his people from Ihiptu. The Ten Law which is known to many, (here) is written here and will_be_seen in chapter twenty (20).
